== Summary ==
Web programmers Dale Maurice and Calvin Sanders keep a watch on DecipherCon Message Boards. Left: [[Dale Maurice]] (tan shirt, headphones, by the iMac). Right: [[Calvin Sanders]] (red jacket). Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Calvin Sanders]], [[Dale Maurice]].
